subject: Pilot readiness — quick confirmation and approval slots
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot readiness — quick confirmation and next steps

Hi Claire — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps from today's discovery: 

- Goals we heard: speed up agent response time on customer support workflows and reduce per-request cost by ~30% through batching + quantization.
- Success criteria: < 150ms p95 for short-chat flows; pilot KPIs tracked by customer CS team.
- Key stakeholders: you (product), procurement (cc'd), and infra (TBD).

Suggested next steps:
1) Share mutual action plan (attached v2) and a starter SOW for procurement to review.
2) Engineering sync (30m) to confirm infra/region choices and sample traffic.
3) Target pilot start: first week of Jan — contingent on procurement sign-off and a short security checklist.

Can you confirm whether procurement has an internal review window this quarter and if the leadership approval path is still on track for an early-Jan kickoff? If timing has shifted, we can move the pilot start later or break the pilot into a smaller first milestone to fit approvals.

I've attached the MAP and an editable SOW for your legal/procurement. If helpful, I can send a calendar with 30-minute slots next week for the engineering sync.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: 2027-12-20-Redwood-MAP-v2.pdf (PDF), catalyst-sow-draft.docx (DOCX)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Catalyst AI Procurement <procurement@catalyst.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2027 10:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness — quick confirmation and next steps

Claire —

Circling back as we head into the final week of the quarter — just checking status on two quick items so we can lock an engineering sync and get the MAP into procurement's queue:

- Has procurement had a chance to review the SOW draft I attached? Any preferred edits or redlines we should incorporate?
- Is leadership still expecting an early-Jan kick-off, or should we plan for mid-Jan based on approval cycles?

If it's easier, here are three times I can offer for a 30m engineering alignment next week (all PST):
- Wed 12/29 11:00–11:30
- Thu 12/30 09:00–09:30
- Fri 12/31 10:00–10:30

If none of those work, tell me a couple slots that do and I'll send an invite. If timing has slipped, totally fine — just want to update our rollout plan so we can coordinate Dedicated capacity reservations if needed.

Thanks for the quick read — even a one-line status helps.
